panels.title: Hosted SQL execution by archive reader

targets.rawSql:
SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at, r.rolname AS reader, count(s.queryid) AS statement_entries, sum(s.calls) AS calls, round(sum(s.total_exec_time)::numeric, 2) AS execution_ms
FROM pg_roles r LEFT JOIN extensions.pg_stat_statements s ON s.userid = r.oid AND s.dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database())
WHERE r.rolname = ${reader:sqlstring}
GROUP BY r.rolname

SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at, count(*) AS clients_including_sampler, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()) AS other_active_visible
FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND backend_type = 'client backend'

panels.title: PP pending rows, age and recent ACKs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at, g.slot, g.generation_id, count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.acknowledged_at IS NULL) AS pending_rows,
round(extract(epoch FROM statement_timestamp() - min(o.created_at) FILTER (WHERE o.acknowledged_at IS NULL))::numeric, 3) AS oldest_pending_age_s,
count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.acknowledged_at > statement_timestamp() - interval '60 seconds' AND o.acknowledged_at <= statement_timestamp()) AS acks_last_60s,
round(count(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.acknowledged_at > statement_timestamp() - interval '60 seconds' AND o.acknowledged_at <= statement_timestamp()) / 60.0, 3) AS acks_per_s_last_60s
FROM archive.generations g LEFT JOIN ops.outbox o ON o.origin_id = g.origin_id AND o.generation_id = g.generation_id
WHERE g.origin_id = ${origin:sqlstring} AND g.retired_at IS NULL
GROUP BY g.slot, g.generation_id ORDER BY g.slot, g.generation_id
